svg.title: TRT logo - geometric construction
svg.desc: TRT logo, geometric reconstruction of the approved raster (Layer 1). Coordinates are raster pixels (1 px = 0.5 mm on the page). The logo is two T-like glyphs forming pi, a central double-struck R (real numbers), and three concentric rings. Layer 2 holds editable primitives; Layer 3 holds construction guides; Layer 4 holds derived geometry assembled from the primitives; Layer 5 holds the final logo as clones (linked copies) of Layer 2 and Layer 4 objects. Editing a ring circle or a crossbar rectangle in Layer 2 updates Layer 5 live. Edge primitives (lines and arcs) feed the closed regions in Layer 4 only by re-joining them (select the edges, Path > Combine, close); those regions are not live-linked.

g.inkscape:label: Layer 1 - Original Raster Reference
g.desc: Approved raster artwork, 284x284 px at the origin. Locked. Visual reference only. Hidden by default: show it to compare.

g.inkscape:label: Layer 2 - Geometric Primitives
g.desc: Editable primitives: ring circles, crossbar rectangles, and every straight edge and circular arc of the glyph outlines (arcs are native Inkscape arc objects). Rings and crossbars drive Layer 5 live.

circle.desc: Concentric ring: centre (140.833,138.856), centre-line radius 127.93 px, stroke width 1.78 px. Edit r or stroke-width to change the ring; the final logo follows.

g.inkscape:label: Layer 3 - Construction Guides
g.desc: Centres, radii, joints, alignment lines, bounding boxes and labels. Nothing here is rendered in the final logo.

g.inkscape:label: alignment lines and notes
g.text: Construction guides. Arcs with radius over 150 px (nearly straight stem edges) show only their joints; their centre and radius are in the arc element description in Layer 2.

joints, centres and radii: left glyph: stem and tail edges
joints, centres and radii: right glyph: stem left edge and outer hook

joints, centres and radii: right glyph: inner hook and stem right edge
joints, centres and radii: R: silhouette edges
joints, centres and radii: R: stem hollow edges
joints, centres and radii: R: leg hollow edges
joints, centres and radii: R: bowl counter edges
joints, centres and radii: R: bowl hollow edges
Layer 4 - Intermediate Construction
g.desc: Derived geometry: closed regions assembled from the Layer 2 edges, the R silhouette and hollows, and the even-odd R ink compound path.

path.inkscape:label: left glyph body (serif + stem + tail)
path.desc: Closed region assembled from the L-serif-* and L-stem-* edge primitives (Layer 2). It is closed with lines inside the crossbar (overlap, y=75.0) so the union with the crossbar leaves no seam.

path.inkscape:label: right glyph body (stem + hook)
path.desc: Closed region assembled from the Rr-outer-*, Rr-terminal-* and Rr-inner-* edge primitives (Layer 2), closed with lines inside the crossbar (overlap, y=75.0).

path.inkscape:label: R-silhouette (closed shape)
path.desc: Closed shape for the outer silhouette of the double-struck R, assembled from the R-silhouette-* edge primitives in Layer 2.

path.inkscape:label: R-hole-stem (closed shape)
path.desc: Closed shape for the hollow inside the stem, assembled from the R-hole-stem-* edge primitives in Layer 2.

path.inkscape:label: R-hole-leg (closed shape)
path.desc: Closed shape for the hollow inside the leg, assembled from the R-hole-leg-* edge primitives in Layer 2.

path.inkscape:label: R-hole-bowl-counter (closed shape)
path.desc: Closed shape for the counter (empty space) of the bowl, assembled from the R-hole-bowl-counter-* edge primitives in Layer 2.

path.inkscape:label: R-hole-bowl-ink (closed shape)
path.desc: Closed shape for the hollow inside the thick right side of the bowl, assembled from the R-hole-bowl-ink-* edge primitives in Layer 2.

path.inkscape:label: R ink = silhouette minus 4 hollows (even-odd)
path.desc: Boolean result: silhouette with the four hollows cut out, as one even-odd compound path. Same as Path > Difference of the closed shapes above. Layer 5 clones this.

g.inkscape:label: Layer 5 - Final Reconstructed Logo
g.desc: Final logo. Every object is a clone of a Layer 2 or Layer 4 object. Transparent background.
